purpose: exploratory end-to-end policy comparison, not independent confirmation
partition: stage-55 partition: target i, probe (i+1)%10, candidates remaining eight; original source-index text order
probe: first 64 complete chunks; refreshed gradient at every alignment decision; never updated on
target: all complete chunks; evaluation only before and after each run; never supplied to selection

schedule.generator: numpy default_rng(model_seed); warmup draws then candidate matrix then uniform choices; same table for all arms and repeats within fold/seed
schedule.hash: candidate indices and random choices bytes

alignment_execution: At each step compute probe gradient on a disposable clone. Independently clone current model and optimizer for each of four candidate updates; score actual deltas; retain the winning updated model and optimizer without a second update. All candidates start at the same current state.
random_execution: Clone current model and optimizer and apply one update on the prescheduled uniformly chosen candidate.
tie_rule: first candidate index attaining maximum score
nonfinite_rule: abort and report incomplete; no fallback or silent exclusion
clock: time.perf_counter; start after initial state clone; include candidate indexing, per-step clones, gradients, trial updates, scoring and winner selection
deadline_rule: Check before each step and after full decision. Accept winner only if decision completes within budget. Otherwise return previous accepted model and optimizer. Record wall-clock overrun, attempted steps and accepted updates.
run_order: languages ar then en; folds 0..9; seeds ascending; modes updates then time if (fold+seed)%2==0 else reversed; repeats ascending; arms random then alignment if (fold+seed+repeat)%2==0 else reversed
metric: target cross-entropy per byte transition in natural-log units; evaluate batches of at most 64 chunks
primary: Arabic timed final loss: alignment minus random
aggregation: average timing repeats within fold/seed/arm; average ten folds within seed/arm; compute eight paired seed differences; fixed mode has one repeat

bootstrap.unit: paired model seed after fold and repeat averaging

decision: primary upper confidence bound <0 suggests lower loss under this local policy timer; lower bound >0 suggests worse loss; interval containing zero is inconclusive, not equivalence
failure_rules: No adaptive budget extension, retuning, selective fold removal or outcome-based reruns
Abort on schedule exhaustion or missing cases; do not summarize a partial grid as complete
Document operational interruptions; any resumed/repeated run must be identified and all attempts retained
required_tests_before_execution: hand-computed alignment sign and stable tie-breaking
candidate trials do not mutate current or other candidate states
winner includes matching optimizer state without duplicate update
fake clock rejects late decisions and accepts on-time decisions
target data inaccessible to policy selector
aggregation over fold and repeat respects seed pairing
finite values, complete grid, matching schedules and source hashes
limitations: PUD already exposed; new seeds do not make the corpus independent
Parallel languages are not independent replications
Eight seeds yield conditional uncertainty; no power calculation
Short CPU budgets are hardware-dependent and timing is not byte-reproducible
Random arm uses rollback cloning and is not the fastest possible random trainer
No global compute savings or large-model claim
Alignment uses extra probe supervision; this is a policy comparison, not an isolated weight-feature ablation
